input: Learn basic watercolor techniques on YouTube

gold.taskTitle: Learn basic watercolor techniques on YouTube
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn foundational watercolor painting techniques by watching YouTube videos.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with watercolor?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner or has some prior exposure to watercolor painting.

questions.title: Which specific techniques are you most interested in learning?
questions.description: Identify the techniques the user wants to focus on, such as wet-on-wet, washes, blending, or layering.

questions.title: Do you already have watercolor supplies to practice with?
questions.description: Determine whether the user plans to practice alongside the videos or just watch for now.

questions.title: How much time per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Understand the user's available time to tailor a realistic learning schedule.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or deadline to reach basic proficiency?
questions.description: Clarify whether there is a specific timeframe or milestone the user wants to hit.

questions.title: Are there specific subjects you want to paint, like landscapes or florals?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred subject matter to guide video and technique selection.

questions.title: Do you prefer structured courses or standalone tutorial videos?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a progressive multi-part course or individual topic-based tutorials.
